the article’s text as the site wrote it
, with its subheadings and images, and lays it out cleanly. It rewrites nothing and cuts nothing.

tab with a notification, and they reply with a reaction at the end.

units.Tu peux même enregistrer ou masquer un a: You can even save or hide an article offline: it all syncs as soon as you’re back online.
units.Trois étapes, et le fil démarre: Three steps, and your feed starts
units.Pas d'installation, pas de carte bancair: Nothing to install, no credit card. An e-mail, a password, and you’re in.

units.C'est le nom de ton profil. Les thèmes,: It is your profile’s name. You pick your topics on your first visit.

when you tap a purple button

units.Hodi n'a rien à te vendre. Son code est: Hodi has nothing to sell you. Its code is public, you can run it at home, and this server is offered by the person who hosts it.

units.Oui. Hodi est un logiciel libre, et ce s: Yes. Hodi is free software, and this server is offered by the person who hosts it. No subscription, no ads, no data sold.
units.Toi seul. Ceux à qui tu envoies un artic: Only you. The people you send an article to see that article. The host sees account e-mails, never your reading.
units.Pourquoi des articles s'ouvrent sur le s: Why do some articles open on the site?
units.Les articles réservés aux abonnés ne son: Subscriber-only articles are never bypassed. And depending on this server’s settings, Hodi may show the start of an article, then send you to the publisher for the rest.
units.Rien si tu n'en mets pas. Avec ta clé, c: Nothing if you add none. With your key, each purple button is a paid call to the chosen provider, never automatic, with daily caps.
units.Ils ont leur compte Ado, créé par un par: They get a Teen account, made by a parent: the sources their parents chose, and the hours Hodi opens. They can ask for a new source, their parents decide.
units.Et si le serveur est complet ?: What if the server is full?
units.Inscris-toi sur la file d'attente avec u: Join the waitlist with your e-mail. You get a message as soon as a spot opens, and your e-mail is used for nothing else.
